tools.name: lacrm_get_user
tools.description: Return the user who owns this API key — UserId, name, email and timezone. A cheap way to confirm the key works, and the UserId to use for AssignedTo. LACRM: GetUser.

tools.name: lacrm_list_users
tools.description: List the users on the account that you can see (admins see all), with their UserIds — needed to assign contacts, tasks or filter by owner. LACRM: GetUsers.

tools.name: lacrm_search_contacts
tools.description: Search (or list) contacts and companies. With no search_terms, returns everything visible, paged. Returns { HasMoreResults, Results }. LACRM: GetContacts.

tools.name: lacrm_get_contact
tools.description: Fetch one contact or company record with all its fields (emails, phones, addresses, custom fields, owner). LACRM: GetContact.

tools.name: lacrm_list_notes
tools.description: List notes, newest first by default — across the whole CRM, or for one contact. Filter by date range and author. LACRM: GetNotes.

tools.name: lacrm_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks due in a date range, optionally only incomplete/complete, for given users. If contact_id is given, ALL of that contact's tasks are returned regardless of dates or status. LACRM: GetTasks.

tools.name: lacrm_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events in a date range, filterable by user or calendar. If contact_id is given, all events attached to that contact are returned and other filters are ignored. LACRM: GetEvents.

tools.name: lacrm_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the account's pipelines (e.g. Sales Leads) with their statuses (StatusId, Name, IsActive) and optionally their custom fields. This is the setup, not the items — use lacrm_list_pipeline_items for those. LACRM: GetPipelines.

tools.name: lacrm_list_pipeline_items
tools.description: List the items in one pipeline (deals, leads...), optionally only in given statuses or for given users. An empty status filter returns items in all ACTIVE statuses. LACRM: GetPipelineItems.

tools.name: lacrm_get_contact_pipeline_items
tools.description: All pipeline items attached to one contact or company, grouped by pipeline. LACRM: GetPipelineItemsAttachedToContact.

tools.name: lacrm_list_groups
tools.description: List the contact groups you can see (GroupId, Name, Sharing, Color), optionally with member counts. LACRM: GetGroups.

tools.name: lacrm_list_contacts_in_group
tools.description: List the contacts that are members of one group. Identify the group by group_id (preferred) or group_name — not both. LACRM: GetContactsInGroup.

tools.name: lacrm_get_contact_groups
tools.description: List the groups one contact or company belongs to. LACRM: GetGroupsAttachedToContact.

tools.name: lacrm_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the account's field definitions (name, type, options) for contacts, companies or pipelines — use the Name values as keys in custom_fields when creating/editing contacts. LACRM: GetCustomFields.

tools.name: lacrm_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact (person) or company record. For a person, company_name links them to that company (creating it if needed). Company names must be unique. If assigned_to is omitted, the record is assigned to the API key's own user (one extra GetUser call). Returns { ContactId }. LACRM: CreateCont

tools.name: lacrm_edit_contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact or company. Only the fields you pass change; omitted fields are left alone. Multi-value fields (email, phone, address, website) are REPLACED by the list you pass. Set is_company=true when renaming a company. LACRM: EditContact.

tools.name: lacrm_create_note
tools.description: Attach a plain-text note to a contact or company's history (newlines kept, HTML/markdown escaped). Returns { NoteId }. LACRM: CreateNote.

tools.name: lacrm_create_task
tools.description: Create a to-do on a user's task list (date only, no time — use lacrm_create_event for timed things). Optionally attach it to a contact. Returns { TaskId }. LACRM: CreateTask.

tools.name: lacrm_edit_task
tools.description: Update a task — including marking it complete (is_complete=true) or re-opening it (false). Only passed fields change. LACRM: EditTask.

tools.name: lacrm_create_event
tools.description: Create a timed (or all-day) event on your calendar, optionally with contacts/users as attendees. The timezone of start_date becomes the event's timezone. Returns { EventId }. LACRM: CreateEvent.

tools.name: lacrm_create_pipeline_item
tools.description: Create a pipeline item (deal, lead...) on a contact in a given pipeline and status, with an optional note. Returns { PipelineItemId }. LACRM: CreatePipelineItem.

tools.name: lacrm_update_pipeline_item
tools.description: Move a pipeline item to another status (e.g. Prospect → Won) and/or add a note to its history. LACRM: EditPipelineItem.

tools.name: lacrm_add_contact_to_group
tools.description: Add a contact or company to a group (creates a group membership). Identify the group by group_id (preferred) or group_name — not both. LACRM: CreateGroupMembership.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lacrm_get_user, lacrm_get_contact, lacrm_edit_contact · Private data: lacrm_get_user, lacrm_list_users, lacrm_search_contacts, lacrm_get_contact, lacrm_list_notes, lacrm_list_tasks, lacrm_list_events, lacrm_get_contact_pipeline_items, lacrm_list_groups, lacrm_list_contacts_in_group, lacrm_get_contact_groups, lacrm_list_custom_fields, lacrm_create_contact, lacrm_edit_contact, lacrm_create_note, lacrm_create_task, lacrm_create_event, lacrm_create_pipeline_item, lacrm_add_contact_to_group · Public sink: lacrm_get_user, lacrm_edit_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lacrm_get_user, lacrm_get_contact, lacrm_edit_contact · Private data: lacrm_get_user, lacrm_list_users, lacrm_search_contacts, lacrm_get_contact, lacrm_list_notes, lacrm_list_tasks, lacrm_list_events, lacrm_get_contact_pipeline_items, lacrm_list_groups, lacrm_list_contacts_in_group, lacrm_get_contact_groups, lacrm_list_custom_fields, lacrm_create_contact, lacrm_edit_contact, lacrm_create_note, lacrm_create_task, lacrm_create_event, lacrm_create_pipeline_item, lacrm_add_contact_to_group · Public sink: lacrm_get_user, lacrm_edit_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
